BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Simmons, Scott, Reeves, Hill, and Macri

BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Community Safety.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Prohibiting certain law enforcement agencies from hiring certain federal employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting certain law enforcement agencies from hiring certain federal employees; adding a new section to chapter 10.93 RCW; creating a new section; and providing an effective date.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 10.93 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) A general authority Washington law enforcement agency or a limited authority Washington law enforcement agency may not employ any individual who was hired as a sworn officer of the United States immigration and customs enforcement on or after January 20, 2025.
(2) This section applies prospectively only and does not apply to any individual hired by the agency prior to the effective date of this section.

BillSectionHeader.P: This act may be known and cited as the ICE out act of 2026.
